posts.topic: The Treasury Shortage Nobody Is Hiring To Fix
posts.hook: 61% of finance leaders report a talent shortage. Only 8% are hiring to solve it.
posts.key_stat: 61% report treasury talent shortages; only 8% respond by hiring internationally.
posts.source: Controllers Council, Corporate Finance & Accounting Talent Study 2026
posts.visual_direction: Bold 61% as the dominant figure with a smaller contrasting 8% beside it, clean enterprise stat card emphasizing the gap between the problem and the hiring response.
